missions.title: Squad Negev
missions.description: A few days later, Squad Negev of Grifon was ordered to search for AR-15 in Area S08, but they've gone missing there. Their comms modules are also jammed.

missions.title: Double Rescue
missions.description: The AR Team went in to investigate, and successfully rendezvoused with the squad member dispatched by Negev to send the distress signal. We then lanched the rescue mission.

missions.title: Reunion
missions.description: We fended off "Alchemist". Squad Negev got out of danger, but we've lost track of M4A1 and SOP-II when their signal got blocked again…

missions.title: Prisoner
missions.description: M16A1 found SOP-II unconscious, but a large amount of Sangvis forces have suddenly swarmed into Area S08 so we must move out immediately!

missions.title: Resolve
missions.description: The commander has rebuffed the Sangvis vanguard for the time being, but Negev made a spine-chilling conjecture - AR-15 is the source of the jam...

missions.title: Late Farewell
missions.description: After a long and brutal fight, all T-Dolls have withdrawn from Area S08...except...AR-15...

missions.title: Final Wish I
missions.description: AR-15 was trapped by Alchemist during the withdrawal. Meanwhile, Grifon's troops were also in grave danger...

missions.title: Final Wish II
missions.description: SOP-II took the risk of heading onto the battlefiled and created an opening for AR-15 just in time. She also bought time for the rest of our troops to retreat safely.

missions.title: Final Wish III
missions.description: M16A1 returned with a message from AR-15. As the host of "Parapluie", there's no coming back for her. The only thing she can do is…

missions.title: Final Wish IV
missions.description: AR-15... The commander and I have no idea what you did in the end... All we know is that...you saved all of us...

missions.title: People in the Flask I
missions.description: FAL's Report: The FN squad has begun to investigate the recent missing T-Doll incidents in the area.

missions.title: People in the Flask II
missions.description: FAL's Report: The FN squad has dispatched two T-Dolls, FNC and FN49, to bait our target, Alchemist, into revealing herself.

missions.title: People in the Flask III
missions.description: FAL's Report: The FN squad dispatches an elite T-Doll once again. I think the plan is coming to its final stages.

missions.title: People in the Flask IV
missions.description: FAL's Report: The final step in intercepting Alchemist shall begin with me. I hope 57 and her squad will arrive on time…
